notes.title: [August 29 Korean AMA and Roadmap Update Q&A]
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]This is the DARKEST DAYS.[/p][p][/p][p]As we have previously done, we compiled a list of questions from the community, along with answers that were shared during a special live broadcast held on August 28th.[/p][p][/p][p]Many questions were asked about the recent updates, as well as future game updates.  [/p][p]Please check below for the list of questions and answers.[/p][p]As always, we will do our best to listen to the voices of the survivors to create a more enjoyable game for all![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What was the development intent for Harsh Winter Bielli Island?[/b][/p][p]A. Harsh Winter Bielli Island is currently the most difficult region to date, and party play is recommend for all survivors except maybe the top-tier players. In Harsh Winter Bielli Island, blueprints for SSR equipment can drop, allowing players to collect fragments and craft the equipment themselves.[/p][p]With this region's introduction, the leveling up of your Shelter will also be made easier through this and future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the purpose of existing SSR equipment blueprints (pre-update)?[/b][/p][p]A. We plan to introduce a 1:1 exchange feature for existing completed blueprints, so players can craft the equipment they want. We apologize for not informing everyone of this earlier.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the purpose of introducing party member NPC AI?[/b][/p][p]A. Many survivors requested improvements to the Resident AI, especially regarding unintended aggression from party members.[/p][p]To address this, we added the ability to specify the combat behavior of resident NPCs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Please review the Survivor Levels[/b][/p][p]A. The new season officially kicked off with a lower difficulty level than the previous one.[/p][p]In the latest season, you can acquire the Racing Suit costume.[/p][p]The team was particularly surprised and grateful to see a player reach level 110, which exceeds our expectations. We considered reaching level 80 already a challenging milestone, so we thank the survivor for achieving level 110.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can additional survivor level rewards be added?[/b][/p][p]A. Since survivor level reflects combat-oriented growth, we are not planning to add additional stats.[/p][p]However, we are open to discussing more ideas for enhancing or adding honorary rewards in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the Sheltic Bot system?[/b][/p][p]A. We added a “Sheltic Bot” feature to assist new survivors.[/p][p]However, it may not provide correct answers to all questions, but we plan to continually update and expand its knowledge based on common inquiries.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Were equipment drop rates reduced?[/b][/p][p]A. While new items may affect drop rates for existing items, there are no changes that significantly alter gameplay.[/p][p]Our development philosophy is to enhance the fun of farming equipment within the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can vehicles sent on explorations be used?[/b][/p][p]A. In the upcoming October update, all vehicles can be summoned and used regardless of exploration status.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What was the intent behind the party system improvements?[/b][/p][p]A. We added the ability to create a party and invite others before joining a multiplayer region. Also, additional buffs are provided to encourage party play.[/p][p]Lonetree Tunnel has also been improved to function better with the party system.[/p][p]Players can continue or retry runs more easily after success or failure in Lonetree Tunnel.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Are there any adjustments being made to gun attributes?[/b][/p][p]A. The roadmap initially planned a skill revamp in November, but we feel that the balancing of the guns should be addressed first.[/p][p]Therefore, we will proceed with a rebalancing of the guns before the skill revamp.[/p][p]Updated specs and plans for upcoming updates will be shared soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. How is the party distribution calculated?[/b][/p][p]A. Item distribution depends on the region, while experience is calculated by distance traveled.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. The background of Harsh Winter Bielli Island appears foggy[/b][/p][p]A, We will review this internally and improve it as needed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Twilight Holitore seems to give more XP (than Harsh Winter Bielli Island)[/b][/p][p]A. Harsh Winter Bielli Island provides more XP than Twilight Holitore.[/p][p]Difficulty and hunting conditions will vary, so please consider these factors when trying to level up.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. How is the updated auto-move feature?[/b][/p][p]A. With the auto-move update, the walking seems okay, but driving experience has received negative feedback.[/p][p]We will review this for potential improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can the hunting ground conflict in Harsh Winter Bielli Island be improved?[/b][/p][p]A. The max player count was reduced to 16 for the region, but we may adjust if survivors still face difficulties.[/p][p]A dynamic conflict system is being considered in which the area is temporarily considered a conflict zone if players continuously interfere with each other when hunting and looting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can weapon stats and attributes be shown?[/b][/p][p]A. This will be improved with the upcoming gun attribute updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Any plans to improve the Resident Exploration?[/b][/p][p]A. Some reworks are being considered to fix frequent bugs and prevent the monotonous feel of map areas.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What are the planned updates for October?[/b][/p][p]A. The planned updates are as follows:[/p][p]- Guild Shelter, Guild Conquest, Guild Missions[/p][p]- Halloween season event[/p][p]- SSR firearms: choice of scope or iron sight[/p][p]- Item lock feature[/p][p]- Vehicles sent on exploration can be used[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can XP be displayed as a percentage?[/b][/p][p]A. We'll take this into consideration.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can multiple attachments be used per facility?[/b][/p][p]A. Currently, only one attachment per facility is allowed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can enhancement and resident exploration be used in multiplayer regions?[/b][/p][p]A. As of now, facilities are intended for use at the player’s own shelter, but we will review potential adjustments.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Upgrade is too difficult. How about having Blessed Upgrade Boxes?[/b] [/p][p]A. Discussions are ongoing about preventing level loss during upgrade failures. There is some talk about introducing items to prevent downgrade incase of failure. Although the introduction of such item/system is under discussion, if it is introduced, it will be obtainable from loot or drops rather than as a purchasable item.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can the Exchange be filtered by level?[/b][/p][p]A. The feature is currently planned but not yet implemented. We apologize for the delay.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can a hotkey be added to select specific items when opening Rootland boxes?[/b][/p][p]A. We understand the need and will review it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. A skill preset feature seems to be needed.[/b][/p][p]A. Skill tree presets will be added alongside gun rebalancing in the late November update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is the official release schedule?[/b][/p][p]A. We believe there are still issues and improvements to make before the official release.[/p][p]The release will proceed once current problems are sufficiently addressed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. The penalties in the Conflict Zones seem to be insufficient.[/b][/p][p]A. When defeated in conflict zones, the result is loss of items. [/p][p]We will consider added rewards for victories as well based on feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Are Lonetree Tunnel rebalancing updates planned?[/b][/p][p]A. Currently, there the top survivors are attempting Stage 30. [/p][p]Adjustments in difficult, first-clear rewards, repeatable rewards, and balancing item acquisition to allow better use of consumables and deployable items. are currently in the works.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q. Can the party item distribution for R~SR be adjusted?[/b][/p][p]A. To avoid any complication, distribution settings are standardized for SSR.[/p][p]Adjustments may be considered based on survivor feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you for all your feedback and support![/p][p][/p][p]DARKEST DAYS Team[/p]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes July 17
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7844841adac1b964bcf0bc6922d22f1d761c72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Survivors.[/p][p] [/p][p]We would like to share the patch notes for the version update on Thursday, July 17.[/p][p]Please check the details of this update below.[/p][p]※ Please note that screenshots and images were taken in a test environment, and some changes may occur when applied to the live server.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ Version Information[/b][/h3][p]- 0.21.0[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ New Content[/b][/h3][p][b]New Growth Content – Survivor Level (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- A new growth system, Survivor Level, is added to further strengthen your character.[/p][p]- Survivor Level will be operated on a seasonal basis. This season will run until August 28 (UTC+0).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/ccd0333eeb9ee2affbe591415923631fbe830ed9.png"][/img][/p][p]- The Survivor Level is displayed below the character level.[/p][p]- Like normal, Survivor Level increases by gaining XP through zombie hunting, securing building safety, completing quests, etc.[/p][p]- In this season, reaching Survivor Level 40/80 grants Liam McCarney exclusive outfits (Survival Challenger Outfit / Survival Tactical Outfit) that your player character can wear.[/p][p]- The Survival Challenger and Survival Tactical Outfits are limited rewards available only during this season.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7be57c647091016bb58046efc57b1e644541e0a0.png"][/img]- Survivor Skills and Survivor Level will both reset at the end of the season.[/p][p][/p][p]※ XP handling after reaching Character Level 40 before the Survivor Level update[/p][p]- With the Survivor Level update, all accumulated experience gained beyond level 40 up until now will be applied to the current season's Survivor Level.[/p][p]- Any experience gained beyond level 40 that is not applied this season will not carry over to the next season and will be lost.[/p][p]- Please note that depending on their previous progress, existing survivors may start at a level higher than Level 1.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Growth Content – Survivor Skills (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- Survivor Skills are a new growth feature that boosts various character stats such as weapon attack power, knockdown chance, and max HP.[/p][p]- Survivor Skills can be managed in the menu accessed via a new button next to the character level on the Bag screen.[/p][p]- You can activate various Survivor Skills nodes using Survivor Skill Points. The total stat bonuses from activated nodes are displayed on the right.[/p][p]- Clicking an activated node again will deactivate it and return the used Survivor Skill Points.[/p][p]- Survivor Skills and Survivor Level will both reset at the end of the season.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/da8b1514220543728eaae25fc6c4580e4db53bc0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New System - Guild[/b][/p][p]- A new system, Guild, has been added, allowing you to play together with other survivors.[/p][p]- You can access the guild system from the tablet menu to participate in guild activities, create, or join a guild.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/65f212fdbe7408f3a76425ee1da593c953f43e5c.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can join a guild starting from Character Level 20.[/p][p]  ① You can search for a guild by its name.[/p][p]  ② You can apply to join a guild from the list.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/a07501e3a69a0bcf1ba6c4b9775b5c0512bf9e96.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can create a guild starting from Character Level 20.[/p][p]  ① You can freely customize the guild emblem’s pattern and color.[/p][p]  ② You can set the guild name and a brief introduction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/7a65612379de74ad8781bd2cc49f446d3aedfe38.png"][/img]- If you are in a guild, you can view your guild information.[/p][p]- Guild leaders have access to the \[Manage Guild] menu to edit guild information.[/p][p]  ① You can donate guild funds to your guild.[/p][p]  ② You can view detailed information about guild members.[/p][p]  ③ A “Leave Guild” button is available in the My Info window.[/p][p]  ④ You can check in to your guild.[/p][p]  ⑤ You can edit the emblem, name, and introduction at any time in the \[Manage Guild] menu.[/p][p]  ⑥ You can set the guild joining method.[/p][p]   ㄴ Open: Players can join the guild freely without the guild leader’s approval.[/p][p]   ㄴ Approval: Players can join the guild after the guild leader approves their request.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/35a53e51fb2a68ff4f68562f0c8ca9c6a4aa6f3c.png"][/img][/p][p]- Depending on the guild level, the total number of guild members can increase from a base of 30 to a maximum of 50.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Resident – Liam McCarney / Community Pass Season 3[/b][/p][p]- Liam McCarney dreamed of becoming a soldier, but suffered setbacks every time due to unexpected accidents that prevented him from taking the exam. However, he never gave up and saved many people from the threat known as Black Hound. Now, with more allies by his side, Liam is leading the charge to protect the shelter with unmatched strength.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/0007036ec079587f1606a76e401a09d552165457.png"][/img][/p][p]- Liam McCarney can be obtained from the newly added Community Pass Season 3.[/p][p]- Upon reaching level 40 of the Community Pass, you can also obtain Liam McCarney’s special outfit.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/92f39b232e8ad81b86e46d405ffda9ca4f4d3aec.png"][/img]- You can find the Community Pass in Shop – Package – Community Pass.[/p][p]- The Community Pass can be purchased once per character.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Event – Starfish Collection Event (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- To celebrate the summer season, the Starfish Collection Event will be held.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/79fc8254441c3b91c2b7f8452d4cd8ac900ab3cc.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can obtain Starfish when defeating zombies in Sand Creek, Bielli Island, Pamrein, Holitore, Twilight Holitore, and Rootland.[/p][p]- The Starfish you acquire can be exchanged for various items including swimsuit armor via Shop – General Goods – Starfish Exchange.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/cf05d737746fb6a7ec61966272913dcff3d74500.png"][/img]- Starfish currency will be removed in bulk after the event ends.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 3 New Events (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- A new 7-day attendance event begins.[/p][p]- A new cumulative login event begins.[/p][p]- A new 28-day attendance event begins.[/p][p]　ㄴ Existing Lucky Coupon rewards will be changed to Event Lucky Coupons.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Outfit – Silvermoon Beach Outfit[/b][/p][p]- The new Silvermoon Beach Outfit will be added.[/p][p]- The outfit can be found in Shop – General Goods – Outfit.[/p][p]- The outfit can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p]※ The outfit will appear differently depending on the gender of the character it is equipped on.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/03af4b11bf6f4176e4b2424aa69939cb2c6d2f75.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Pets – White Munchkin, Golden Munchkin[/b][/p][p]- New pets White Munchkin and Golden Munchkin will be added.[/p][p]- The new pets White Munchkin and Golden Munchkin can be found in Shop – Pets.[/p][p]- Each pet can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/3d8c939ea3f40c5c877651e58b8f51d7befe52ca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Limited-Time Packages – Season 3. Surprise Upgrade Package, Season 3. Advanced Upgrade Package, Season 3. Special Upgrade Package (~8/28/25)[/b][/p][p]- To celebrate Season 3, limited-time packages will be released.[/p][p]- These packages can be found in Shop – Package – Limited-Time Package.[/p][p]- Each package can be purchased 1, 3, and 3 times respectively per character.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Package – Beginner-Only Lucky Package[/b][/p][p]- This package will pop up when the \[Shop] content is unlocked.[/p][p]- It can only be purchased for 3 hours after the pop-up appears.[/p][p]- It can only be purchased once per character.[/p][p]* For survivors who have already unlocked the \[Shop] content, the Beginner-Only Lucky Package will pop up the first time you log in after the update.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Key Improvements[/b][/h3][p]New Feature: Hide Appearance[/p][p]- A new feature to hide hats, bags, and outfits will be added.[/p][p]- A button will be added at the bottom of the Bag screen to toggle hat, bag, and outfit appearance On/Off.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/6dec7794f2c122a5cedde1a0682b1181fdcd0e95.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Support for 6 New Languages[/b][/p][p]- Support will be added for 6 additional languages.[/p][p]- The newly supported languages are German, French, Italian, Russian, Turkish, and Thai.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/b1086011da5f7ba7071848a108e754924a1ed978.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Co-op Raid Improvements[/b][/p][p]- The score earned from defeating zombies other than the boss in co-op raids has been increased.[/p][p]- In co-op raids, raid rewards will now be Upgrade Tool Boxes with random grades (N~SR) instead of fixed-grade Upgrade Tools.[/p][p]- Only successful co-op raids will now count toward your multiplayer ranking score.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][p]- Headshot damage against player characters has been adjusted from 2x to 1.5x.[/p][p]- The main stats of some gear have been increased by 10%.[/p][p]  ㄴ SSR-grade ranged weapon attack power increased by 10%.[/p][p]  ㄴ SSR-grade armor defense increased by 10%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Standard Monthly Membership Improvements[/b][/p][p]- A buff will now be provided upon purchase of the Standard Monthly Membership.[/p][p]- Buff effects provided are as follows:[/p][p]  ● Character XP gain +10%[/p][p]  ● Party Member Resident XP gain +10%[/p][p]  ● Milla gain when killing zombies +10%[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/18bfebaca4d0c383f048e0e661dd390fc1231185.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Shop[/b][/p][p]- The purchase limit for the 1+1 products in Shop – Currency – Red Diamonds will now be reset every month.[/p][p]- The daily purchase limit of various Proofs sold in Shop – General Goods – Training Tools has been increased from 1 to 3.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Additional Improvements[/b][/h3][p]- The default setting for ranged attack assist is now ‘Auto Fire’.[/p][p]- When Auto Fire is on, the HUD fire button will display a visual effect.[/p][p]- On mobile, the Auto Fire option will not activate upon scope zoom.[/p][p]- Improved the quest progression flow for levels 1–5.[/p][p]- Added a pop-up to notify players when product info fails to load upon entering the Shop.[/p][p]- Purchase buttons for scenario packages will now activate according to quest progress regardless of previous purchase.[/p][p]- Belongings will now immediately appear when entering the Rootland entry screen.[/p][p]- A pop-up notification will now appear if you try to enter Rootland while still holding items.[/p][p]- Settings can now be changed from the title screen settings, excluding shortcut keys.[/p][p]- Screen resolution, resolution quality, and V-sync settings can now be configured on the PC client.[/p][p]- When moving items between locker and belongings, you can now use +/– buttons to set to max or min quantity.[/p][p]- When claiming rewards from the cumulative login event, activated previous rewards will also be given along with the selected one.[/p][p]- Changed Residents’ attention-drawing skill to a distraction skill.[/p][p]- All functions and unlock times for each Shelter facility are now displayed. (7/18 02:00 UTC)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]- Fixed an issue where residents in Resident Expedition would sometimes not engage in combat.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where stamina would not recover after combat in Resident Expedition.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some residents would not participate in combat in Resident Expedition.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where zombies in city maps of Resident Expedition would not move correctly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the aim assist option would activate on non-hostile targets.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where item quantity was shown on icons when moving weapons or armor in the locker screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where text would overflow from the maintenance pop-up.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where text in Lucky Box probability info and draw history pop-ups would overflow.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where icons would float far away in the kill log.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the vehicle stat gauge was incorrectly displayed.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where text overflowed in the friend screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where a shortcut key change icon appeared in the HUD when entering Sand Creek after character creation.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the character disappeared after closing the item info window via back button in the Bag screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where resident management and gear enhancement tutorials would not display properly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the player could die during the pet tutorial.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where cutscenes overlapped after finishing the tutorial.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the red dot notification in the Bag did not appear or disappear as intended.[/p][p]- Adjusted the objective count for the “Racing Prep 4” quest and fixed an issue where the quest is completed unintentionally.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where incorrect text was displayed in some quest objectives.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the TAS sub-menu would sometimes not appear or refresh properly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where TAS Sniper Assist did not function properly.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where fire rate did not work properly depending on the frame cap setting of the device.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where enemies could dodge during a finishing move.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the report button appeared in the results screen even when the player did not die in Rootland.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where invincibility was not applied upon entering Rootland.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the player screen appeared when tapping locker from the resident screen in Twilight Holitore.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where pre-deployed vehicles could not be summoned immediately when entering a zone.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where object placement or textures were incorrect in Holitore.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where resident professional skills did not work in multiplayer zones.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where debuff durations were abnormally applied in multiplayer zones.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the download button remained visible even after downloading the multiplayer zone map.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where stamina was not consumed when sprinting with a gun equipped in multiplayer zones.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where HP and stamina bars were not displayed correctly in the Bag screen in multiplayer zones.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the screen turned black when opening supply boxes in multiplayer zones.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where players had to re-enter the shop to purchase Lucky Boxes after buying Lucky Coupons.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the scroll bar did not work properly on the right list of limited-time packages.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where party residents would sometimes not attack zombies.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where an error occurred when using a coupon after changing the character name.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the client would crash or disconnect from the server abnormally.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where fences collided with objects when summoning a vehicle from the parking lot.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where newly dropped gear from level 36+ elite/epic zombies had incorrect level settings.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some objects in Sand Creek were not displayed when the graphics quality was set to "Low" on PC. (7/18 02:00 UTC)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the new update![/p][p] [/p][p]DARKEST DAYS Team[/p]

notes.title: [Update] Thursday June 25th – Patch Notes (Edited)
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the DARKEST DAYS, Trust No One![/p][p][/p][p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]This is the DARKEST DAYS.[/p][p] [/p][p]The patch notes for the latest updated version on Wednesday, 6/25 are here![/p][p]※ All screenshots and images were taken in a test environment and may differ from the live server version.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ Version Info[/b][/h3][p]- iOS/AOS/PC: 0.20.1[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]■ New Additions[/b][/h3][p][b]New Content – Resident Expedition[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/5b949007e30b478b5b8d5a0cc8ef8aae0b6e711f.png"][/img]- New content, ‘Resident Expedition’, has been added[/p][p]- ‘Resident Expedition’ will be available as a permanent addition after the update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/4e676ed79b9e1c28ae2418f907e3c751f0e308f2.png"][/img][/p][p]- ‘Resident Expedition’, which is available starting from Exploration Room Level 5, can be entered through the Shelter > Exploration Room[/p][p]- Form an expedition team with your residents and use your vehicles to begin exploring.[/p][p]- The number of residents you can include in an expedition depends on the vehicle’s seating capacity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/39ea7e9a8147e66734de9fc1366e2edbf8b93a4d.png"][/img][/p][p]- ‘Resident Expedition’ takes place on a new board-style map where you can move one tile at a time.[/p][p]- Various events (combat, rewards, buffs) may be available through each tile.[/p][p]- Rewards vary by event and can include Milla, equipment, and Resident EXP.[/p][p]- In addition, fuel needed for movement in ‘Resident Expedition’ is used through ‘Gas Tank’, with one ‘Gas Tank’ allowing for five tile moves.[/p][p]- If a resident dies during the exploration, they can be revived in the Shelter or can be revived by another resident through the use of a Defibrillator in their inventory to rejoin the expedition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/9033098e19d07196256d1630d78881a84ee1902c.png"][/img][/p][p]- Click ‘End Expedition’ found through Shelter > Exploration Room > Resident Expedition to end the expedition and receive the acquired rewards.[/p][p]- After the current expedition has ended, a new one can be started.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/c588e05672dd2400050f590152b242bfe1bbcb76.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Multiplayer Area – Twilight Holitore[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/ab8b96c70911ceef02ce3ee47c6cacf750b84f07.png"][/img]- New multiplayer area, ‘Twilight Holitore’, has been added.[/p][p]- ‘Twilight Holitore’ is accessible from character level 40, and it features more challenging zombies (Levels 41-45).[/p][p]- The new area will be a PvE-only area with no conflict zones.[/p][p]- All items available in the original Holitore, proofs required for resident breakthrough, and hard-to-find facility blueprints can be acquired in ‘Twilight Holitore’.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/f2efacb5304378c53fcba775e28f82ca98ab6ea0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Vehicle - Ambulance[/b][/p][p]- The newest vehicle, ‘Ambulance’ features a larger trunk for more item storage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/79e7ed385cefd0c4bfcca8db4dfcdd0c51da9788.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Equipment - Tommy, Hunter Armor[/b][/p][p]- New weapons and gear added.[/p][p]- These new items will be obtainable through drops in-game or Pickup Lucky Boxes.[/p][p]- The Hunting-themed armor includes 4 SSR-grade pieces.[/p][p]- The Tommy, known for having a high magazine capacity, is a new SMG with four grades ranging from N to SSR.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/76009578a45f47489e154e9189e370e79e49cbd0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Pickup Lucky Box - Tommy, Hunting Armor[/b][/p][p]- To celebrate the release of new equipment, a Pickup Lucky Box will be available for all until Wednesday, August 6, 04:59 PT[/p][p]- The new box offers increased notes.title: June 5 Korean AMA & Roadmap Update Q&A
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481144/015e99361963e498fb4be886e1b40c28f17cd584.jpg"][/img]

[b]Q. What happens to EXP after reaching level 40?[/b]
A. EXP will now continue to accumulate beyond level 40.
All EXP previously earned through quests will also accumulate and be applied as well.
An issue that causes EXP values to display as an infinite amount is currently being fixed.

[b]Q. The Community Pass rewards seem to have changed. Can you let us know why?[/b] 
A. Starting this season, the Community Pass has been revamped to offer more variety and themed rewards. The final reward is a skin for the new resident, Kyla Jane. Going forward, we plan to align rewards with each season’s theme.

[b]Q. There seems to be a bug with Kyla Jane's quests.[/b]
A. We’ve identified the issue preventing quest progression and will fix it. Also, some of Kyla Jane’s quests unlock the following day because they are based on in-game time. 

[b]Q. What’s changing in the PVE content?[/b]
A. For survivors who prefer PVE content over PVP, ER can now be earned from PVE activities. Killing Contaminated Flowers, Zombie Hordes, Titans, and Gigas will now reward you with ER.
Also, an ER supply system through the Shelter facilities is in development, and ER acquisition in Rootland has been increased.

[b]Q. The residents block the view too much.[/b]
A. We’ve received a lot of feedback regarding this.
The first phase of improvement patch prevents residents from blocking your line of fire.
In the next update, a “Combat Stance” setting will also be introduced.

[b]Q. Will there be more ways to level up residents?[/b]
A. Yes! A new "Resident Expedition" feature is coming.
You can send residents on expeditions using gas tanks, and they’ll grow through the process.
Now you’ll be able to level-up residents in different ways and not just through hunting or combat manuals.

[b]Q. Reporting abnormal players in Rootland is too inconvenient.[/b]
A. We plan to add a report function that lets you report the opposition directly when your character dies.
We are also continuously strengthening systems to prevent abuse via third-party programs.

[b]Q. Are new guns and armor always OP?[/b]
A. We are focusing on continuously adding distinctive and not overpowered gear.
Each piece of equipment is designed to support specific roles and play styles.

[b]Q. I heard there's going to be a Survivor Level system?[/b]
A. Yes, starting from the June 5 update, a new growth system based on accumulated EXP is being added.
We plan to offer seasonal growth content, and reaching certain levels will unlock cosmetic rewards.

[b]Q. Are guild systems coming too?[/b]
A. Yes, we’re currently developing it!
We’re exploring features like Guild Housing and potential Guild Wars mode (tentative).
Our goal is to enable more group-oriented play.

[b]Q. I’m not happy with the Boss Raid Contribution Scoring system.[/b]
A. Actions like killing zombies and rescuing other survivors will be better reflected in your score.
Also, the reward structure will also be adjusted to reflect these new changes.

[b]Q. What about the skill system revamp?[/b]
A. We’ve received feedback that the current system lacks some uniqueness.
We’re working on a complete overhaul that allows skills to meaningfully change gameplay, and not just add stats.
Details will be shared once this new system is finalized.

[b]Q. Armor feels too weak.[/b]
A. We agree. We've internally acknowledged the low efficiency of armor upgrades and are discussing improvements.

[b]Q. How are you addressing multi-account issues?[/b]
A. We’re actively monitoring multiple accounts connecting from the same device or IP.
Only accounts with clear signs of suspicious activity will be sanctioned, so regular users need not worry.

[b]Q. Will there be an equipment inheritance system?[/b]
A. Currently, there are no plans for this type of system, but we will revisit it at a later time.

[b]Q. Losing all your items upon death in Rootland is quite scary.[/b]
A. Many new players are unintentionally dropping items upon entering Rootland.
We are working on in-game solutions and considering systems like a Safe Box to preserve certain items.
[b]
[/b]Q. When will the weapon balance adjustments happen?
A. Buffs to SSR weapons will come first and then, we plan to rebalance underused weapons like melee, pistols, and others.

[b]Q. Enhancement stress is too high…[/b]
A. We believe the current structure in which growth past level 40 relies heavily on gear is the core issue.
We're introducing the Survivor Level system to provide alternative growth paths.
We also agree that the current enhancement downgrade experience is a bit too harsh and are discussing improvements. However, due to interconnected balance issues, we can’t announce specific changes just yet.

[b]Q. The new resident’s appearance is underwhelming.[/b]
A. We’ll be sure to upgrade the visual quality.

[b]Q. Why can’t residents and players share outfits?[/b]
A. The character models are different, so they can't use the same clothes directly.
However, we plan to introduce NPC outfits that players can unlock through Survivor Level rewards in the future.

[b]Q. Are you doing stealth patches?[/b]
A. Definitely not. All balances and content changes are always announced in advance to the community.

[b]Q. Zombies don’t seem to bite anymore?[/b]
A. The early game had biting and QTE (Quick-time event) to escape, but we removed it as it didn’t fit our current direction.
Now zombies are designed to attack without a grab mechanic.

[b]Q. Shelter facilities don’t feel useful.[/b]
A. We’re adjusting the system values so the benefits of facilities will be more noticeable.

[b]Q. Where can I get blueprints?[/b]
A. Residents over level 20 can obtain blueprints through Expeditions.
They can also be earned through Achievement rewards.
We plan to add more blueprint drops in new content like Holitore Hard and Resident Expeditions.

[b]Q. Can we search by prefix in the marketplace?[/b]
A. Yes, we’re adding a prefix search feature so you can find specific item options more easily.

[b]Q. Push rewards feel too weak.[/b]
A. Starting this season, push rewards will be increased.

[b]Q. How is game security being improved?[/b]
A. As of the June 5 update, the client-side security has been strengthened.
If the game is launched alongside suspicious programs, it may not run.
DARKEST DAYS takes a strict stance against unauthorized software usage.

[b]Q. Are macros allowed?[/b]
A. Macros using external programs are prohibited.
We’re discussing policy on hardware vendor-provided macros and will share details once finalized.

[b]Q. Where can iOS users enter coupons?[/b]
A. Coupons can be redeemed through the official website.

[b]Q. What about other feedback?[/b]
A. We’re reviewing or implementing the following:
- Displaying hidden stats on gear
- Item lock function
- Chat-linked item sharing
- Auto ammo reload
- Bulk repair / Storage features
- Additional zombie types
- Beginner-friendly Rootland matchmaking
- Loot system overhaul (e.g., zombies drop items instantly)
- Improvements to low-level area quests
- Default quantity improvements when moving items to storage
- Skill reset item availability across level milestones[/p]
